        int n, m, source, sink;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] e;

        public FlowNetwork(int n, int source, int sink) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = 0;
            this.source = source;
            this.sink = sink;
            e = new ArrayList[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {

            edge[m + 1].v = a;
            edge[m + 1].c = 0;

        int[] d;
        int[] done;
        int[] path;

        public void _bfs() {

            Arrays.fill(c, 0);
            Arrays.fill(d, n);
            d[sink] = 0;
            q.add(sink);

                c[d[cur]]++;

                    d[v] = d[arc.v] + 1;
                    done[v] = i;
                }
            }
            c[d[v]]++;
        }

        public int _augment() {

            int flow = 0x7fffff;

                edge[id].c -= flow;

            }

    static void bfs(int n, char[][] sci) {
